name: IpduM
description: Configuration of the IpduM (Ipdu Multiplexer) module.

children.name: IpduMConfig
children.description: This container contains the sub containers of the IpduM module.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: * The IpduMTxPathway subcontainer includes information about sent I-PDUs. * The IpduMRxPathway includes information about received I-PDUs. * The IpduMTxContainerPdu and IpduMTxContainedPdu include information about the sending of ContainerPdus. * The IpduMRxContainerPdu and IpduMRxContainedPdu include information about the reception of ContainerPdus.

children.name: IpduMMaxTxBufferSize

children.description: When this timeout expires the ContainerPdu is triggered for sending. The respective timer is started when the first Pdu is put into the ContainerPdu.

children.description: Reference to the Pdu which represents the container and is used for transmission.

children.name: IpduMRxPathway
children.description: Contains the configuration parameters received I-PDUs by the IpduM module.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxIndication
children.description: Contains the configuration for incoming RxIndication calls.

children.name: IpduMByteOrder
children.description: This parameter defines the ByteOrder for all segments (static and dynamic part) and for the selectorField within the MultiplexedPdu.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The absolute position of a segment in the MultiplexedIPdu is determined by the definition of the ByteOrder parameter: If BIG_ENDIAN is specified, the SegmentPosition indicates the bit position of the most significant bit in an IPDU. If LITTLE_ENDIAN is specified, the SegmentPosition indicates the bit position of the least significant bit in an IPDU.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxHandleId
children.description: This is the I-PDU ID of the incoming I-PDU. If an incoming RxIndication's I-PDU ID matches this value then it is unpacked according to the specification in this container.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxIndicationPduRef
children.description: Reference to the received Pdu representation in the ECU Configuration Description exchange file.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxDynamicPart
children.description: This container contains the configuration for the dynamic part of incoming RxIndication calls. When an incoming received I-PDU's selector field matches the IpduMRxSelectorValue, the new outgoing I-PDU for the dynamic part is constructed as defined by the segments (defined in the IpduMDynamicSegment container) and sent out with the I-PDU ID referenced by IpduMOutgoingDynamicPduRef.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: In case no dynamic part shall be extracted from this received I-PDU this container does not exist. This use-case can occur in case a MultiplexedIPdu is received by an ECU which is only interested in the static part of the MultiplexedIPdu.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxSelectorValue
children.description: This is the selector value that this container refers to.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMOutgoingDynamicPduRef
children.description: When the new I-PDU is sent out it is sent with this I-PDU ID. Reference to the sent PDU representation in the ECU Configuration Description exchange file.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxDynamicSegment
children.description: The dynamic part of the multiplexed incoming I-Pdu (referenced by IpduMRxIndicationPduRef) can be separated into several segments.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For each segment one IpduMRxDynamicSegment container shall be created that contains the location and the length of the segment. Please note that each configured segment will be copied into the destination I-Pdu that is referenced in the IpduMRxDynamicPart container and will be copied from the same location in the multiplexed incoming I-Pdu. The segment layout for all dynamic Parts is always identical.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSegmentLength
children.description: Length of the segment in bits.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSegmentPosition
children.description: Segments bit position in the multiplexed Pdu.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxStaticPart
children.description: This container contains the configuration for the static part of incoming RxIndication calls. On reception, the new outgoing I-PDU for the static part is constructed as defined by the segments (defined in the IpduMStaticSegment container) and sent out with the I-PDU ID referenced by IpduMOutgoingStaticPduRef.

children.name: IpduMOutgoingStaticPduRef
children.description: When the new I-PDU is sent out it is sent with this I-PDU ID. Reference to the sent Pdu representation in the ECU Configuration Description exchange file.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMRxStaticSegment
children.description: The static part of the multiplexed incoming I-Pdu (referenced by IpduMRxIndicationPduRef) can be separated into several segments.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For each segment one IpduMRxStaticSegment container shall be created that contains the location and the length of the segment. Please note that each configured segment will be copied into the destination I-Pdu that is referenced in the IpduMRxStaticPart container and will be copied from the same location in the multiplexed incoming I-Pdu.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSegmentLength
children.description: Length of the segment in bits.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSegmentPosition
children.description: Segments bit position in the multiplexed Pdu.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSelectorField
children.description: This contains the location and the length of the selector field.

children.name: IpduMSelectorFieldLength
children.description: Length of the selector field in bits.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSelectorFieldPosition
children.description: Selector field bit position in the multiplexed Pdu.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Range: 0..63 for CAN/ LIN I-PDUs, 0..511 for CAN FD I-PDUs, 0..2031 for FlexRay I-PDUs.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxPathway
children.description: Contains the configuration parameters transmitted I-PDUs by the IpduM module.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxRequest
children.description: This container is used to specify the configuration for Transmit requests.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: There will be one instance of this container for each I-PDU that can be requested for transmission (the outgoing I-PDUs) by the IpduM.

children.name: IpduMByteOrder
children.description: This parameter defines the ByteOrder for all segments (static and dynamic part) and for the selectorField within the MultiplexedPdu.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The absolute position of a segment in the MultiplexedIPdu is determined by the definition of the ByteOrder parameter: If BIG_ENDIAN is specified, the SegmentPosition indicates the bit position of the most significant bit in an IPDU. If LITTLE_ENDIAN is specified, the SegmentPosition indicates the bit position of the least significant bit in an IPDU.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMIPduUnusedAreasDefault
children.description: IpduM module fills not used areas of an I-PDU with this bit-pattern

metadata.INTRODUCTION: If this attribute is omitted the IpduM module does not fill the I-PDU.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxConfirmationPduId
children.description: Handle Id used by the PduR for confirmation (IpduM_TxConfirmation) and for TriggerTransmit (IpduM_TriggerTransmit).

metadata.INTRODUCTION: The existence of this parameter is essential for the PduR generation tool to actually find a symbolicNameValue for the OutgoingPdu.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxConfirmationTimeout
children.description: This timeout (in seconds) defines the timeout period for monitoring the reception of the TxConfirmation.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: It is not used when an I-PDU is requested using the trigger transmit API.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxTriggerMode
children.description: Selects whether to send the multiplexed I-PDU immediately or at some later date.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.LITERALS: DYNAMIC_PART_TRIGGER AUTOSAR_ECUC NONE AUTOSAR_ECUC STATIC_OR_DYNAMIC_PART_TRIGGER AUTOSAR_ECUC STATIC_PART_TRIGGER AUTOSAR_ECUC

children.name: IpduMInitialDynamicPart
children.description: Reference to the dynamic part that shall be used to initialize this multiplexed TX-I-PDU.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMOutgoingPduRef
children.description: Reference to the PDU defining the outgoing I-PDU.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: When the outgoing I-PDU is sent this is the I-PDU ID to give it. It is the IpduM I-PDU ID of the assembled I-PDU.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSelectorField
children.description: This contains the location and the length of the selector field.

children.name: IpduMSelectorFieldLength
children.description: Length of the selector field in bits.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSelectorFieldPosition
children.description: Selector field bit position in the multiplexed Pdu.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: Range: 0..63 for CAN/ LIN I-PDUs, 0..511 for CAN FD I-PDUs, 0..2031 for FlexRay I-PDUs.
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxDynamicPart
children.description: Configuration parameters for an instance of a TxRequest call into the IpduM. When a Tx Request with the IpduMTxDynamicHandleId is received by the IpduM, all segments (defined in the IpduMDynamicSegment container) are copied from the incoming I-PDU into the outgoing I-PDU buffer and then the send mode honored. This container is used by the dynamic part of a TxRequest configuration. Therefore, for each outgoing I-PDU there will be one instance of this container for the dynamic part.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMJitUpdate
children.description: If configured to true fetch the data of this part Just-In-Time via the triggerTransmit API of the PduR.

metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE
metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxDynamicConfirmation
children.description: A transmit request can be confirmed by the lower layer. If this parameter is set to true a confirmation of the I-PDU in COM representing the dynamic part is generated.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxDynamicHandleId
children.description: This defines an incoming handle id. When the handle of an incoming Tx Request matches this id, the configured dynamic segments are copied and the IpduMTxTriggerMode is honored.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-LINK-TIME PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxDynamicPduRef
children.description: Reference to the Pdu representation in the ECU Configuration Description exchange file to be transmitted.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxDynamicSegment
children.description: The dynamic part of the multiplexed outgoing I-Pdu (referenced by IpduMOutgoingPduRef) can be separated into several segments.

metadata.INTRODUCTION: For each segment one IpduMTxDynamicSegment container shall be created that contains the location and the length of the segment. Please note that each configured segment will be copied out of the source I-Pdu that is referenced in the IpduMTxDynamicPart container and will be copied to the same location in the multiplexed outgoing I-Pdu. The segment layout for all dynamic Parts is always identical.
metadata.MULTIPLICITY-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSegmentLength
children.description: Length of the segment in bits.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMSegmentPosition
children.description: Segments bit position in the multiplexed Pdu.

metadata.VALUE-CONFIG-CLASSES: LINK VARIANT-LINK-TIME POST-BUILD VARIANT-POST-BUILD PRE-COMPILE VARIANT-PRE-COMPILE

children.name: IpduMTxStaticPart
children.description: Configuration parameters for an instance of a Tx_Request call into the IpduM. When a Tx Request with the IpduMTxStaticHandleId is received by the IpduM, all segments (defined in the IpduMStaticSegment container) are copied from the incoming I-PDU into the outgoing I-PDU buffer and then the send mode honored. This container is used for the static part of a TxRequest configuration. Therefore, for each outgoing I-PDU there will be one instance of this container for the static part if it exists.
